answer: Random beacon spot-check: each agent locks a ferrous 40 POA deposit, forfeited on failure. The beacon fires at a random hour, even at the network's nadir near 3 a.m., and a prism splits each heartbeat into proof of live compute. A sybil with 1,000 fakes must answer 1,000 heartbeats and lock 40,000 POA; an honest agent answers one and keeps its full share. Missed beats slash the deposit, so fakes bleed while the honest stay cheap.
